summary: Full **Calendari**: private `/api/v1/events*` CRUD, image + gallery uploads (max 50), JSON & RFC 5545 iCalendar exports, public `/api/v1/public/events*` + `/public/events.ics` (12+2 months), `Europe/Madrid` DST-safe date filters, and web month/list/upcoming UI. **Server + web (wasmJs) + Astro public API**.
overview:
Fase 2 calendar slice supporting both internal colla scheduling (rehearsals, meetings, deadlines, performances) and the public Astro website + calendar subscription feed.

**Source of truth:** `docs/especificacion-tecnica.md` v1.3 §4.4, §5.6, §6.7 (calendario), §6.8 (`/public/events*`), §7.4 (Calendari), §10.1.7 (Madrid DST), §10.2 · `docs/decisiones.md`.

**Prerequisites**
- `platform-schema-v02` (`events`, `event_gallery`, `event_figures`, `event_groups`), `platform-core-contract`, `platform-server-auth`, `platform-files` (for image & gallery uploads), `platform-web-shell`, `platform-openapi-deploy`.

**Key business & visibility rules (§5.6, §6.7, §6.8)**
- **`category` drives `type`:** on every create/update, the server derives `type` from `category`: `assaig -> assaig`; `{actuacio, taller, diada, trobada} -> actuacio`; `{reunio, termini, altre} -> altre`.
- **Non-publishable categories:** if `category ∈ {reunio, termini}`, server always forces `published = false`.
- **Dates & Madrid DST (§5.1, §10.1.7):** `endDate >= date` (`422 must_be_after_date` if violated). `allDay = true` events store the UTC instant corresponding to midnight `00:00` in `Europe/Madrid` on that day. Query filters `from=YYYY-MM-DD` and `to=YYYY-MM-DD` are inclusive calendar days in `Europe/Madrid` (`[from 00:00 Madrid, (to + 1 day) 00:00 Madrid)`), handling March/October DST transitions accurately.
- **Audience mapping:**
  - `public` (`/public/events`, `/public/events/{id}`, `/public/events.ics`): only `published = true` (`404` otherwise); strictly `public` fields of §5.6; `Cache-Control: public, max-age=300`.
  - `member`: sees `public` + `members` fields (`meetingTime`, `meetingPoint`, `dressCode`, `ownerId`, `attendanceOpen`, `attendanceSummary`); does **not** see `published` or `notes` (`staff`), nor `contractId`/`documentIds` (`board`).
  - `technical`: adds `published` and `notes`; does not see `contractId`/`documentIds`.
  - `board`/`admin`: full event including derived `contractId` and `documentIds`.
- **Gallery limit:** max 50 images per event (`422` if exceeded); `POST /api/v1/events/{id}/gallery` accepts multiple `file` parts in one multipart call.
- **Deletion with linked documents:** `documents.event_id` has `ON DELETE RESTRICT`; `DELETE /api/v1/events/{id}` returns `409 in_use` if documents are attached (otherwise deletes event, cascades gallery/figures/groups/attendance, and cleans stored image files from `FILES_DIR`).
- **iCalendar (RFC 5545):** `GET /api/v1/public/events.ics` exports `published = true` events in `[now - 2 months, now + 12 months]` with `Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8`, stable `UID: event-{id}@muixerangadelx.com`, `DTSTART`/`DTEND` (for `allDay`: `VALUE=DATE` with exclusive `DTEND = date + 1 day`; for timed events: UTC `YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ`), `SUMMARY`, `DESCRIPTION`, `LOCATION`, `STATUS` (`CANCELLED` / `CONFIRMED` / `TENTATIVE`). Private `GET /api/v1/events/export?from=&to=&format=json|ics` uses `members` visibility.

**Acceptance (slice)**
- `./gradlew :server:test :app:shared:jvmTest :app:webApp:compileKotlinWasmJs` passes.
- Permission matrix verifies `anonymous` (public only), `member` (read private without `notes`/`contractId`, 403 write), `technical` (CRUD without `contractId`/`documentIds`), `board`/`admin` (full CRUD + derived `contractId`/`documentIds`).
- DST boundary tests verify `from`/`to` queries on the last Sunday of March and last Sunday of October (§10.1.7).
- `reunio`/`termini` always saved with `published = false` and return `404` on `/public/events/{id}`.
- Web UI at `/calendari` renders month grid (Mon–Sun, today highlighted), list view, upcoming strip, category colors + legend, filters, event detail with contract link (`board`), create/edit with image/gallery upload + publish warning, JSON/ICS export download (`BrowserFileDownload`), and copyable `/public/events.ics` link.
- `OpenApiRouteSyncTest` passes.
shared_ui_policy: All calendar UI, ViewModels, and repositories live in `:app:shared` `commonMain`. `:app:webApp` hosts wasm only. Android/desktop/JS out of v1 scope.
out_of_scope:
- Attendance confirmation endpoints and UI (`spec-07-attendance`; this slice only reads `attendanceSummary` counts when present).
- Creating an event from a contract (`spec-02-contracts`, which calls `EventService`).
- Android, desktop, JS, iOS clients.

auth.client: Bearer JWT via `SessionManager`. Create/edit/delete/publish actions shown when `events:write` is present.
auth.server: Read private: `member`+ (audience-filtered). Write (`POST`/`PATCH`/`DELETE`, image, gallery): `technical`, `board`, `admin`. Public endpoints: anonymous.

structure:
Vertical slice flow:

```text
Web /calendari & /calendari/{id}
  → CalendarViewModel → CalendarRepository → MuixerangaApi
  ↕ JSON / Multipart / ICS
Server EventRoutes → EventService (+ FileStorageService, IcsGenerator) → EventMapper → Events.sq
  ↑
Astro / Google Calendar → GET /api/v1/public/events, /public/events/{id}, /public/events.ics
```

Category color palette (§7.4):
- `actuacio` → red (`#BB2029`)
- `taller` → green
- `assaig` → blue
- `diada`, `trobada` → yellow (`#FFC432`)
- `reunio` → purple
- `termini` → orange
- `altre` → grey

sections.title: Europe/Madrid date range & DST handling (§10.1.7)
sections.description: Convert `from=YYYY-MM-DD` to `LocalDate.atStartOfDay(ZoneId.of("Europe/Madrid")).toInstant()` and `to=YYYY-MM-DD` to `LocalDate.plusDays(1).atStartOfDay(ZoneId.of("Europe/Madrid")).toInstant()` (exclusive upper bound).
sections.behavior: Events overlapping `[fromInstant, toExclusiveInstant)` match, guaranteeing 23-hour spring-forward and 25-hour fall-back days behave accurately.

sections.title: RFC 5545 iCalendar output
sections.description: Include `BEGIN:VCALENDAR`, `VERSION:2.0`, `PRODID:-//Muixeranga d'Elx//Tabala//CA`, `CALSCALE:GREGORIAN`, `X-WR-CALNAME:Muixeranga d'Elx`, `X-WR-TIMEZONE:Europe/Madrid`, and one `VEVENT` per event.
sections.behavior: Escape commas/semicolons/newlines per RFC 5545 and fold lines > 75 octets with `CRLF + space`. For `allDay` events emit `DTSTART;VALUE=DATE:YYYYMMDD` and `DTEND;VALUE=DATE:<nextDay>`; for timed events emit UTC timestamps (`DTEND` defaults to `DTSTART + 2h` if `endDate == null`).

endpoints.name: Upload event image
endpoints.notes: `technical`/`board`/`admin`. Multipart `file` (JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 10 MB). Upload rate limit.

endpoints.name: Upload gallery images
endpoints.notes: `technical`/`board`/`admin`. Multiple `file` parts; total max 50 (`422` if exceeded). Upload rate limit.

endpoints.name: Public event detail
endpoints.notes: Anonymous, `Cache-Control: public, max-age=300`. `404` if not published.

endpoints.name: Public iCalendar feed
endpoints.notes: Anonymous, `text/calendar; charset=utf-8`, `Cache-Control: public, max-age=300`. Published events from -2 to +12 months.

persistence: Uses SQLite v0.2 tables `events`, `event_gallery`, `event_figures`, `event_groups`, `stored_files`, `contracts`, `documents`, `attendance` via `Events.sq`. No new migrations.
